notes: S3-FIX2 (decision 2026-11-18 #2), S3-FIX2/N2 (decision 2026-11-18 #3): a valid zip container also holds readable/a twice, first as a Unix symbolic link, then as a regular file. The link fails its own checks (§11.9), and its name is remembered all the same, so the regular file is a duplicate name and fails its checks too: E_CONTAINER_ENTRY, and no readable/ entry passed its own checks, so N_READABLE_PRESENT is not reported (§11.8). A verifier that checks every entry but forgets the names of failing ones would take the second readable/a for the first of its name and report the notice.
